sources.note: CareCloud main site. Describes company as publicly traded (NASDAQ: CCLD), serving 40,000+ providers. Lists EHR, RCM, PM, Breeze patient engagement, AI tools (cirrusAI, stratusAI). Mentions talkEHR and Archivus as integrated platforms.

talkEHR product homepage. Describes cloud-based EHR for independent practices, 70+ specialty templates, voice assistant, integrated telehealth, lab connectivity, scheduling, billing, mobile apps. Starting at $249/provider/month.

ONC mandatory disclosures page. States no additional fee for talkEHR. Lists certification #15.04.04.2790.Talk.01.01.1.181217 (Dec 2018), 47 ONC criteria, Surescripts v10.6, EMR Direct, 27 CMS quality measures. MFA at no additional cost.
talkEHR overview page. Lists core modules: EHR, Practice Management, Medical Billing, Financial Analytics (PBilite), Telehealth, Mobile Health Apps. User testimonial about reduced clicks.
talkEHR EHR features page. Details: 70+ customizable charting templates, integrated dictation, ePrescribing, automatic diagnosis predictions, secure messaging, lab ordering, web-based access.

Detailed talkEHR product overview. Lists EHR ($249/mo), PM, billing (5% of reimbursements), telehealth, PrecisionBI Lite ($20/mo). Mobile apps: talkPHR, talkCheckin, talkRX, talkDictate, Anesthesia App. EHR stores medical history, medications, immunizations, diagnoses, treatment plans, radiology images, test results.

Mobile apps page. talkPHR: patient scheduling, demographics, lab results, claims, telehealth. talkCheckin: patient intake, demographics, claims, payments. talkRX: e-prescribing, refills, drug alerts. talkDictate: voice-to-text clinical notes. Anesthesia App: surgery schedules, clearinghouse, document imaging, RCM.

CEO interview about talkEHR. Describes AI clinical reasoning engine, comprehensive reporting/analytics for RCM, multi-specialty support (cardiology, dermatology, pediatrics), 24/7 support, goal to be global market leader in EMR.

Comprehensive CareCloud review. Reveals three distinct EHR products: CareCloud Charts, talkEHR, VertexDR. Details scheduling (color-coded calendar), patient portal (Breeze), billing with CollectiveIQ rules engine, reporting (PDF/XLS/CSV export), telehealth. Pricing $349-$628/provider. Notes steep learning curve and high costs.

talkEHR reviews (3.9/5 from 16 reviews, 69% positive). Highlights 70+ templates, voice recognition, telehealth, lab connectivity, scheduling, insurance claims, analytics. Users praise secure portal, lab integration. Cons: complex setup, improvable diagnosis predictions.

Capterra reviews for talkEHR. Users praise ePrescribe including controlled substances, telemedicine, ease of use, graphical display, remote access, fax capabilities. Criticisms: increasing bugs, eRx recording issues, limited features vs competitors, inability to batch-submit claims.
Wikipedia article on CareCloud (attempted but 403). Search results confirmed: founded 1999 as MTBC, talkEHR launched 2017, CareCloud Corp acquired 2020 for $36M, renamed to CareCloud Inc 2021.
Healthcare IT News on MTBC acquiring CareCloud Corp in January 2020 for $36 million ($17M cash + 760K preferred shares).
MTBC press release about talkEHR signing customers in 42 states in first month of 2017 rollout (page could not be loaded due to SSL cert issue, info from search snippet).
Search result snippet: All three CareCloud EHR platforms (talkEHR, Charts, VertexDR) received updated ONC certifications with standardized APIs, encryption, and latest Surescripts standards.
